properties.name: PackageId
properties.doc: The id of the package; the assembly name by default.

properties.name: PackageVersion
properties.doc: The version of the package; Version by default.

properties.name: Title
properties.doc: A human-friendly title of the package.

properties.name: Authors
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated authors.

properties.name: Company
properties.doc: The company of the assembly and the package.

properties.name: Product
properties.doc: The product name of the assembly.

properties.name: Description
properties.doc: The description of the package and of the assembly.

properties.name: Copyright
properties.doc: The copyright notice.

properties.name: PackageTags
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated tags for the search.

properties.name: PackageProjectUrl
properties.doc: The home page of the project.

properties.name: RepositoryUrl
properties.doc: The URL of the source repository.

properties.name: RepositoryType
properties.doc: The kind of the repository.

properties.name: RepositoryBranch
properties.doc: The branch the package is built from.

properties.name: RepositoryCommit
properties.doc: The commit the package is built from.

properties.name: PackageLicenseExpression
properties.doc: An SPDX license expression.

properties.name: PackageLicenseFile
properties.doc: A license file packed into the package; needs a None item with Pack=true.

properties.name: PackageRequireLicenseAcceptance
properties.doc: The client asks to accept the license.

properties.name: PackageIcon
properties.doc: An icon file packed into the package; needs a None item with Pack=true.

properties.name: PackageReadmeFile
properties.doc: A readme packed into the package; needs a None item with Pack=true.

properties.name: PackageReleaseNotes
properties.doc: The release notes of the version.

properties.name: PackageOutputPath
properties.doc: Where the .nupkg goes.

properties.name: GeneratePackageOnBuild
properties.doc: Pack on every build.

properties.name: IncludeSymbols
properties.doc: Produce a symbols package.

properties.name: SymbolPackageFormat
properties.doc: The format of the symbols package.

properties.name: IncludeSource
properties.doc: Put the sources into the symbols package.

properties.name: IncludeBuildOutput
properties.doc: Pack the assembly; false for a package of content or build logic only.

properties.name: IncludeContentInPack
properties.doc: Pack the Content items.

properties.name: BuildOutputTargetFolder
properties.doc: The folder of the assembly in the package instead of lib: analyzers/dotnet/cs, tools, build.

properties.name: ContentTargetFolders
properties.doc: The folders of the Content items in the package, content;contentFiles by default.

properties.name: DevelopmentDependency
properties.doc: The package is for development only: consumers get PrivateAssets=all.

properties.name: SuppressDependenciesWhenPacking
properties.doc: The package declares no dependencies.

properties.name: PackageType
properties.doc: The kind of the package.

properties.name: PackAsTool
properties.doc: Pack as a .NET tool (dotnet tool install).

properties.name: ToolCommandName
properties.doc: The command the tool is run by.

properties.name: MinClientVersion
properties.doc: The lowest NuGet client that can install the package.

properties.name: NoPackageAnalysis
properties.doc: Skip the package analysis of pack.

properties.name: NuspecFile
properties.doc: A .nuspec to pack from instead of the properties.

properties.name: NuspecProperties
properties.doc: Semicolon-separated key=value pairs for the tokens of the .nuspec.

properties.name: EnablePackageValidation
properties.doc: Check the package for breaking changes and framework inconsistencies after pack.

properties.name: PackageValidationBaselineVersion
properties.doc: The released version the API is compared with.
